acceptanceCriteria: Each staged and public adopter acceptance job runs its harness from the workflow execution checkout while --source-repo points to a separate immutable target-tag checkout.
A regression test fails if an acceptance job uses the target tag as its harness checkout or fails to provide the separate source checkout, and passes when both identities are explicit.
Source and workflow identities are both recorded in hosted acceptance evidence, and the existing staged/public acceptance behavior remains unchanged.

The release workflow policy gate enforces the same split: product/build jobs retain their target-source binding, while all adopter jobs use github.sha for orchestration and release-source for immutable source identity.
goal: Separate workflow execution identity from immutable release source identity in every staged and public adopter acceptance job, with regression coverage that prevents an old tag script from being executed.
intent: Ensure release acceptance executes the current workflow orchestration while validating source and artifact identity from the immutable target Release.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Staged install and N-1 jobs execute the acceptance harness from github.sha while passing a separate target-tag checkout as --source-repo.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run both release acceptance regression scripts and inspect the workflow job blocks.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Public install and public-artifact N-1 jobs use the workflow execution checkout for orchestration and the immutable target tag only for source identity.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run both release acceptance regression scripts and inspect all four public and staged job blocks.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The separate release-source checkout is bound to the requested to_tag and remains the source repository supplied to the harness.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect workflow ref and path bindings and run the harness static regressions.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A regression fails when a release acceptance job checks out the target tag as its harness source or omits the separate immutable source checkout.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the assertions against the pre-fix shape and then the fixed workflow.
